text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to obtain approval to prohibit parking at all times on the north side of Sidney Belsey Crescent, on either side of the first driveway access west of Weston Road. The request for the installation for this regulation came from the area Councillor who was contacted by the property manager of the townhouse complex located at 1500 Weston Road, to improve sight lines and traffic safety.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the north side of Sidney Belsey Crescent from a point 42 metres west of Weston Road to a point 22.5 metres further west.
